name: Dragonrage
description: Erupt with draconic fury and exhale Pyres at 3 enemies within 25 yds.\n\nFor 18 sec, Essence Burst's chance to occur is increased to 100%.

name: Oppressing Roar
description: Let out a bone-shaking roar at enemies in a cone in front of you, increasing the duration of crowd controls that affect them by 50% in the next 10 sec.

name: Tip the Scales
description: Compress time to make your next empowered spell cast instantly at its maximum empower level.

name: Zephyr
description: Conjure an updraft to lift you and your 4 nearest allies within 20 yds into the air, reducing damage taken from area-of-effect attacks by 20% and increasing movement speed by 30% for 8 sec.

name: Landslide
description: Conjure a path of shifting stone towards the target location, rooting enemies for 15 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.

name: Cauterizing Flame
description: Cauterize an ally's wounds, removing all Bleed, Poison, Curse, and Disease effects. Heals for 1,330 upon removing any effect.

name: Rescue
description: Swoop to an ally and fly with them to the target location. Clears movement impairing effects from you and your ally.

name: Eternity Surge
description:
Focus your energies to release a salvo of pure magic, dealing 4,218 Spellfrost damage to an enemy. Damages additional enemies within 25 yds when empowered.

I:   Damages 1 enemy.

II:  Damages 2 enemies.

III: Damages 3 enemies.

name: Quell
description: Interrupt an enemy's spellcasting and prevent any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 6 sec.

name: Expunge
description: Expunge toxins affecting an ally, removing all Poison effects.

name: Obsidian Scales
description: Reinforce your scales, reducing damage taken by 30% . Lasts 12 sec.

name: Verdant Embrace
description: Fly to an ally and heal them for 4,020, or heal yourself for the same amount.

name: Pyre
description: Lob a ball of flame, dealing 1,530 Fire damage to your target and all enemies within 8 yds.

name: Renewing Blaze
description: Obsidian Scales surrounds you with a Renewing Blaze, causing 100% of the damage it prevented to be healed back over 8 sec.

name: Sleep Walk
description: Disorient an enemy for 20 sec, causing them to sleep walk towards you. Damage has a chance to awaken them.

name: Source of Magic
description: Redirect your excess magic to a friendly healer for 1 hour. When you cast an empowered spell, you restore 0.25% of their maximum mana per empower level. Limit 1.

name: Spatial Paradox
description: Evoke a paradox for you and a friendly healer, allowing casting while moving and increasing the range of most spells by 100% for 10 sec.\n\nAffects the nearest healer within 60 yds, if you do not have a healer targeted.

name: Time Spiral
description: Bend time, allowing you and your allies within 40 yds to cast their major movement ability once in the next 10 sec, even if it is on cooldown.

name: Fury of the Aspects
description: Increases haste by 30% for all party and raid members for 40 sec.\n\nAllies receiving this effect will become Exhausted and unable to benefit from Fury of the Aspects or similar effects again for 10 min.

name: Tail Swipe
description: Lash out with your tail, knocking enemies within 8 yds into the air.

name: Emerald Blossom
description: Grow a bulb from the Emerald Dream at an ally's location. After 1.5 sec, heal up to 3 injured allies within 10 yds for 1,222.

name: Blessing of the Bronze
description: Weave the threads of time, reducing the cooldown of a major movement ability for all party and raid members by 15% for 1 hour.

name: Deep Breath
description: Take in a deep breath and fly to the targeted location, spewing molten cinders dealing 2,464 Volcanic damage to enemies in your path.\n\nRemoves all root effects. You are immune to movement impairing and loss of control effects while flying.

name: Hover
description: Launch yourself and gain 30% increased movement speed for 6 sec.\n\nAllows Evoker spells to be cast while moving and is castable while casting. Does not affect empowered spells.

name: Azure Strike
description: Project intense energy onto 2 enemies, dealing 612 Spellfrost damage to them.

name: Disintegrate
description: Tear into an enemy with a blast of blue magic, inflicting 2,410 Spellfrost damage over 2.7 sec, and slowing their movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

name: Fire Breath
description:
Inhale, stoking your inner flame. Release to exhale, burning enemies in a cone in front of you for 2,311 Fire damage, reduced beyond 5 targets.

Empowering causes more of the damage to be dealt immediately instead of over time.

I:   Deals 631 damage instantly and 1,681 over 20 sec.

II:  Deals 1,112 damage instantly and 1,176 over 14 sec.

III: Deals 1,628 damage instantly and 672 over 8 sec.

name: Living Flame
description: Send a flickering flame towards your target, dealing 892 Fire damage to an enemy or healing an ally for 2,280.

name: Return
description: Brings a dead party member back to life with 35% health and mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Swoop Up
description: Grab an enemy and fly with them to the target location.

name: Chrono Loop
description: Trap the enemy in a time loop for 5 sec. Afterwards, they are returned to their previous location and health. Cannot reduce an enemy's health below 20%.

name: Time Stop
description: Freeze an ally's timestream for 5 sec. While frozen in time they are invulnerable, cannot act, and auras do not progress.\n\nYou may reactivate Time Stop to end this effect early.

name: Divide and Conquer
description: Deep Breath forms curtains of fire, preventing line of sight to enemies outside its walls and burning enemies who walk through them for 2,736 Fire damage. Lasts 6 sec.

name: Dreamwalker's Embrace
description: Verdant Embrace tethers you to an ally, increasing movement speed by 40% and slowing and siphoning 475 life from enemies who come in contact with the tether.\n\nThe tether lasts up to 10 sec or until you move more than 30 yards away from your ally.

name: Nullifying Shroud
description: Verdant Embrace wreathes you in arcane energy, preventing the next full loss of control effect against you. Lasts 3 sec.

name: Obsidian Mettle
description: While Obsidian Scales is active you gain immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects.

name: Scouring Flame
description: Fire Breath burns away 2 beneficial Magic effects from all targets.

name: Unburdened Flight
description: Hover makes you immune to movement speed reduction effects.

name: Aerial Mastery
description: Hover gains 1 additional charge.

name: Ancient Flame
description: Casting Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace reduces the cast time of your next Living Flame by 40%.

name: Animosity
description: Casting an empower spell extends the duration of Dragonrage by 5 sec.\n\nEach time this occurs during Dragonrage, its effectiveness is reduced by 25%.

name: Arcane Intensity
description: Disintegrate and Azure Strike deal 8% more damage.

name: Ashes in Motion
description: Fire Breath's cooldown is reduced by 5 sec.

name: Attuned to the Dream
description: Your healing done and healing received are increased by 2%.

name: Azure Celerity
description: Disintegrate deals damage 25% more often, but deals 10% less damage.

name: Azure Essence Burst
description: Azure Strike has a 15% chance to cause an Essence Burst, making your next Disintegrate or Pyre cost no Essence.

name: Azure Sweep
description:
Eternity Surge upgrades your next Azure Strike to Azure Sweep, damaging all nearby enemies and dealing 75% additional damage.

 Azure Sweep
Concentrate azure energy into your tail and sweep to release pure magic upon an enemy and nearby targets for 633 Spellfrost damage. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

name: Blast Furnace
description: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.

name: Bombardments
description: Mass Disintegrate marks your primary target for destruction for the next 6 sec.\n\nYou and your allies have a chance to trigger a Bombardment when attacking marked targets, dealing 1,805 Volcanic damage split amongst all nearby enemies.

name: Bountiful Bloom
description: Emerald Blossom heals 2 additional allies.

name: Burning Adrenaline
description: Fire Breath reaches its maximum empower level 20% faster.

name: Burnout
description: Fire Breath damage has 16% chance to cause your next Living Flame to be instant cast, stacking 2 times.

name: Catalyze
description: While channeling Disintegrate your Fire Breath on the target deals damage 100% more often.

name: Causality
description: Disintegrate reduces the remaining cooldown of your empower spells by 0.50 sec each time it deals damage.\n\nPyre reduces the remaining cooldown of your empower spells by 0.40 sec per enemy struck, up to 2.0 sec.

name: Charged Blast
description: Your Blue damage increases the damage of your next Pyre by 2%, stacking 20 times.

name: Clobbering Sweep
description: Tail Swipe's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.

name: Command Squadron
description: While flying during Deep Breath you are assisted by a squadron of Dracthyr who assault enemies with Pyre, dealing 675 Fire damage to nearby enemies up to 8 times.

name: Concentrated Power
description: Mass Disintegrate strikes 1 additional target.

name: Conduit of Flame
description: Critical strike chance against targets above 50% health increased by 15%.

name: Consume Flame
description: Disintegrate damage consumes 1.0 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 150% of the amount consumed.\n\nPyre damage consumes 4 sec of Fire Breath from enemies it damages, detonating it for 115% of the amount consumed.

name: Deep Exhalation
description: Fire Breath's damage over time lasts 4 sec longer.

name: Diverted Power
description: Bombardments have a chance to generate Essence Burst.

name: Draconic Instincts
description: Your wounds have a small chance to cauterize, healing you for 30% of damage taken. Occurs more often from attacks that deal high damage.

name: Draconic Legacy
description: Your Stamina is increased by 6%.

name: Engulfing Blaze
description: Living Flame deals 10% increased damage and healing and its cast time is reduced by 0.3 sec.

name: Enkindle
description: Essence abilities are enhanced with Flame, dealing 20% of healing or damage done as Fire over 8 sec.

name: Enkindled
description: Living Flame deals 3% more damage and healing.

name: Essence Attunement
description: Essence Burst stacks 2 times.

name: Essence Well
description: Fire Breath has a 50% chance to generate Essence Burst.

name: Eternity's Span
description: Eternity Surge hits twice as many targets.

name: Event Horizon
description: Eternity Surge's cooldown is reduced by 3 sec.

name: Expanded Lungs
description: Fire Breath's damage over time is increased by 30%. Dream Breath's heal over time is increased by 30%.

name: Extended Battle
description: Essence abilities extend Bombardments by 1 sec.

name: Extended Flight
description: Hover lasts 4 sec longer.

name: Exuberance
description: While above 75% health, your movement speed is increased by 10%.

name: Eye of Infinity
description: Eternity Surge deals 15% increased damage to your primary target.

name: Feed the Flames
description:
After casting 6 Pyres, your next Pyre will explode into a Firestorm.

 Firestorm
An explosion bombards the target area with white-hot embers, dealing 5,509 Fire damage to enemies over 10 sec.

name: Fire Torrent
description: Twin Flame bounces to up to 2 additional targets.

name: Foci of Life
description: Renewing Blaze restores you more quickly, causing damage you take to be healed back over 4 sec.

name: Font of Magic
description: Your empower spells' maximum level is increased by 1, and they reach maximum empower level 20% faster.

name: Forger of Mountains
description: Landslide's cooldown is reduced by 30 sec, and it can withstand 200% more damage before breaking.

name: Fulminous Roar
description: Fire Breath deals its damage 20% more often.

name: Hardened Scales
description: Obsidian Scales reduces damage taken by an additional 10%.

name: Heat Wave
description: Fire Breath deals 20% more damage.

name: Heavy Wingbeats
description: Wing Buffet's cooldown is reduced by 2 min.

name: Honed Aggression
description: The critical strike chance of your spells is increased by 2%.

name: Imminent Destruction
description: Deep Breath reduces the Essence costs of your next 4 Disintegrates and Pyres by 1. Stacks up to 8 times.

name: Inherent Resistance
description: Magic damage taken reduced by 2%.

name: Innate Magic
description: Essence regenerates 5% faster.

name: Inner Radiance
description: Your Living Flame and Emerald Blossom are 30% more effective on yourself.

name: Instinctive Arcana
description: Your Magic damage done is increased by 2%.

name: Iridescence
description: Casting an empower spell increases the damage of your next 2 spells of the same color by 20% within 10 sec.

name: Lay Waste
description: Deep Breath's damage is increased by 20%.

name: Leaping Flames
description: Fire Breath causes your next Living Flame to strike 1 additional target per empower level.

name: Legacy of the Lifebinder
description: Fire Breath gains an additional charge.

name: Lifecinders
description: Obsidian Scales also applies to your target or 1 nearby injured ally at 50% value.

name: Lush Growth
description: Green spells restore 5% more health.

name: Maneuverability
description:
Deep Breath can now be steered in your desired direction.

In addition, Deep Breath burns targets for 2,554 Volcanic damage over 12 sec.

The duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.

name: Mass Disintegrate
description: Empower spells cause your next Disintegrate to strike up to 3 targets. When striking fewer than 3 targets, Disintegrate damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.

name: Mass Eruption
description: Empower spells cause your next Eruption to strike up to 3 targets. When striking less than 3 targets, Eruption damage is increased by 10% for each missing target.

name: Melt Armor
description: Deep Breath causes enemies to take 20% increased damage from Bombardments and Essence abilities for 12 sec.\n\nThe duration of this effect is extended when Deep Breath is cast multiple times.

name: Menacing Presence
description: Knocking enemies up or backwards reduces their damage done to you by 15% for 8 sec.

name: Might of the Black Dragonflight
description: Black spells deal 20% increased damage.

name: Natural Convergence
description: Disintegrate channels 20% faster.

name: Nimble Flyer
description: While Hovering, damage taken from area of effect attacks is reduced by 10%.

name: Obsidian Bulwark
description: Obsidian Scales has an additional charge.

name: Onslaught
description: Entering combat grants a charge of Burnout, causing your next Living Flame to cast instantly.

name: Onyx Legacy
description: Deep Breath's cooldown is reduced by 1 min.

name: Overawe
description: Oppressing Roar removes 1 Enrage effect from each enemy, and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

name: Panacea
description: Emerald Blossom and Verdant Embrace instantly heal you for 760 when cast.

name: Potent Mana
description: Source of Magic increases the target's healing and damage done by 3%.

name: Power Nexus
description: Increases your maximum Essence to 6.

name: Power Swell
description: Casting an empower spell increases your Essence regeneration rate by 100% for 4 sec.

name: Protracted Talons
description: Azure Strike damages 1 additional enemy.

name: Recall
description: You may reactivate Deep Breath within 3 sec after landing to travel back in time to your takeoff location.

name: Refined Essence
description: Essence abilities deal 15% additional damage.

name: Regenerative Magic
description: Your Leech is increased by 2%.

name: Rising Fury
description: While Dragonrage is active you gain Rising Fury every 6 sec, increasing your haste by 4%, stacking up to 5 times.

name: Ruby Embers
description: Living Flame deals 115 damage over 12 sec to enemies, or restores 217 health to allies over 12 sec. Stacks 3 times.

name: Ruby Essence Burst
description: Your Living Flame has a 20% chance to cause an Essence Burst, making your next Disintegrate or Pyre cost no Essence.

name: Scarlet Adaptation
description: Store 20% of your effective healing, up to 857. Your next damaging Living Flame consumes all stored healing to increase its damage dealt.

name: Scintillation
description: Disintegrate has a 15% chance each time it deals damage to launch a level 1 Eternity Surge at 40% power.

name: Scorching Embers
description: Enemies affected by Fire Breath's damage over time effect take 25% increased damage from your Red spells.

name: Shape of Flame
description: Tail Swipe and Wing Buffet scorch enemies and blind them with ash, causing their next attack within 4 sec to miss.

name: Shattering Stars
description:
Eternity Surge additionally releases a Shattering Star at your target that deals 50% more damage per empower level reached.

 Shattering Star
Exhale a bolt of concentrated power from your mouth at the target for 661 Spellfrost damage.

name: Slipstream
description: Deep Breath resets a charge of Hover.

name: Spellweaver's Dominance
description: Your damaging critical strikes deal 230% damage instead of the usual 200%.

name: Star Salvo
description: Increases Shattering Star damage by 35%.\n\nShattering Stars are exhaled at all of your Eternity Surge targets.

name: Strafing Run
description: Deep Breath deals 20% increased damage and can be cast again within 18 sec of being used.\n\nRecall will be available after the second cast if talented.

name: Stretch Time
description: While flying during Deep Breath, 100% of damage you would take is instead dealt over 10 sec.

name: Strike from Above
description: Glide speed and height increased by 10%.

name: Tailwind
description: Hover increases your movement speed by 70% for the first 4 sec.

name: Terror of the Skies
description: Deep Breath stuns enemies for 3 sec.

name: Titanic Precision
description: Living Flame and Azure Strike have 1 extra chance to trigger Essence Burst when they critically strike.

name: Titanic Wrath
description: Essence Burst increases the damage of affected spells by 15.0%.

name: Trailblazer
description: Hover and Deep Breath travel 40% faster, and Hover travels 40% further.

name: Twin Flame
description: Consuming Essence Burst fires a twin flame, striking your target for 684 Fire damage.

name: Twin Guardian
description: Rescue increases movement speed by 100% and allows spells to be cast while moving for 3 sec.

name: Tyranny
description: During Deep Breath and Dragonrage you gain the maximum benefit of Mastery: Giantkiller regardless of targets' health.

name: Unravel
description: Direct damage from Fire Breath consumes absorb shields from enemies, dealing 4,552 additional Spellfrost damage to them.

name: Unrelenting Siege
description: For each second you are in combat, Azure Strike, Living Flame, and Disintegrate deal 1% increased damage, up to 15%.

name: Volatility
description: Pyre has a 15% chance to flare up and explode again on a nearby target.

name: Walloping Blow
description: Wing Buffet and Tail Swipe knock enemies further and daze them, reducing movement speed by 70% for 4 sec.

name: Wingleader
description: Bombardments reduce the cooldown of Deep Breath by 0.5 sec for each target struck, up to 1.5 sec.

name: Wing Buffet
description: With a powerful flap of your wings, knock away enemies in front of you.

description: Casting an empower spell increases the damage of your next $386353u spells of the same color by $386353s1% within $386353d.

name: Iridescence: Red
description: Casting an empower spell increases the damage of your next $386353u spells of the same color by $386353s1% within $386353d.
